caption: The drawing depicts a pair of moccasins positioned to display both the front and back views. Both moccasins are primarily a light turquoise blue color, made from buffalo skin, with a high shaft extending above the ankle. The moccasin on the left is shown from a front-angle perspective and has a pinkish-brown cuff that folds over, with matching pinkish fringe hanging down one side. Around the ankle area, this moccasin features pink decorative bands with brown circular elements, and a strap wraps around the foot. The moccasin on the right is positioned to reveal more of the interior and back, with its cuff bent outward and colored a deep reddish-pink. Both moccasins have defined creases and shading to indicate texture and volume. The background of the drawing is plain, and there is red handwritten text below the illustration giving details about the objects, including the tribe, purpose, material, height, and artist’s information with a date and location.
title: Dance Moccasins
